entries.title: Exodus 10:2
segments: The glory of God in the manifestation of his true character, is one great design of all his dispensations towards the children of men.

entries.title: Exodus 10:4
segments: Locusts; a species of insect resembling our grasshopper, but much larger.  They fly with the wind in immense swarms that darken the air, and where they alight they cover the face of the ground, and devour every green thing.

entries.title: Exodus 10:7
segments: The wickedness and obstinacy of rulers are often the means of great calamities to the people.  And when, instead of being what they ought to be, ministers of God for good, they become ministers of evil, it is right for the people by suitable means to seek a change for the better.

entries.title: Exodus 10:10
segments:
Be so with you, as I will let you go; may he deal with you just so as I shall let you go.  He means, I will not let you go; and if your God grants your requests in the same way that I do, you will fare hard. 
 
  Look to it; for evil is before you; that is, according to our version, by persisting in your demand you will bring upon yourselves destruction.  Compare
.  But many prefer to render, Consider that your designs are evil.

entries.title: Exodus 10:11
segments: When men become convinced that they must yield to God or perish, their yielding is often partial, or in pretence merely; and when they find that their submission must be sincere, and that they must in all things follow the will of God, they sometimes become vexed and determine that they will not regard him.

entries.title: Exodus 10:13
segments: East wind; locusts come to Palestine and Egypt from their breeding places in the Arabian desert on the east.

entries.title: Exodus 10:17
segments:
This death only; this deadly plague, implying that he would not give occasion to Jehovah to send another. 
 
Increasing sin brings increasing misery; and men often earnestly seek deliverance, not from the love and practice of iniquity, but from its consequences.

entries.title: Exodus 10:19
segments: The Red sea; which lies east of Egypt.  It is common for locusts to perish in this way.

entries.title: Exodus 10:21
segments: Even darkness which may be felt; rather, so that one shall grope in darkness.

entries.title: Exodus 10:28
segments: However great the miseries which the sins of men bring upon them, if left without the grace of God to pursue their own chosen way, they will grow worse and worse till they perish.
